independent_mathematical_check.intersection: A relation in two bases with zero intersection forces both partial sums zero, hence all coefficients zero. Their union would span an (n+1)-dimensional subspace of n-dimensional V. Thus each relevant intersection contains a nonzero vector.
independent_mathematical_check.attainment: The unique orthogonal decomposition defines a linear projection P_S. P_S T restricted to S is self-adjoint and has the same quadratic form as T on S. Its finite real spectral basis yields attained minimum and maximum Rayleigh quotients.
independent_mathematical_check.outer_extrema: The eigenvector spans U_k and W_k attain the outer max and min after the dimension-intersection bounds; k=1 and k=n work without modifications.
independent_mathematical_check.assumptions: Only finite-dimensional real inner product structure and self-adjointness are used. No choice or new topological assumption is added.
independent_mathematical_check.source_reference_claim: No external PDF reading is claimed; these finite-dimensional arguments were independently derived from the actual local suppliers.
